items.stem: Why must a refactor be backed by tests?

options.text: Tests confirm behaviour is preserved while the code changes
options.rationale: Correct: tests guard against behaviour changes during refactoring.
Tests do not increase refactor size.

options.text: Tests remove the need for review

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep Codex-assisted refactoring under human control? (Select TWO)

options.text: Keep each change small and reviewable
options.rationale: Correct: small changes are easier to review and revert.

options.text: Be able to revert a change that breaks a test
options.rationale: Correct: a revert path limits blast radius.

options.text: Run one large automated refactor with no revert path
Let Codex approve its own pull request
options.rationale: A human reviewer, not the agent, should approve.

items.explanation: Correct: small changes are easier to review and revert.
